instrument_name: Instructions for Form IT-203 (2025) Nonresident and Part-Year Resident Income Tax Return; DTF nonresident FAQ
authority: NY Department of Taxation and Finance
article_or_section: Residency; allocation of days (convenience of employer); FAQ telecommuting
figure_or_rule_carried: Full-text scan of the 47-page official instructions: no reference to reciprocal agreements. Rules read: statutory resident if permanent place of abode substantially all year and 184 days or more in NY (any part of a day counts); Group A nonresident test 30 days or less; days worked outside NY allowed only if due to necessity, not convenience, of the employer (TSB-M-06(5)I cited). DTF nonresident FAQ: credit for tax paid to another authority only on income sourced to and taxed by that authority while a NY resident; no reciprocity text. IT-2104-I has no nonresident or reciprocity section. Conclusion: no reciprocity agreement located; treated as none (absence in nonresident return instructions and FAQ).
